newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK INSURANCE EYES LATVIA, LITHUANIA.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSAPANK INSURANCE EYES LATVIA, LITHUANIA.

text.p: The insurance subsidiary of Hansapank wants to expand into the neigbouring Baltic states of Latvia and Lithuania, Hansapank Kindlustusselts (Hansapank Insurance Company) said on Monday.
"We want to approve the tactical plan for Latvia by July 1," Hansapank Kindlustusselts chairman Mart Einpalu told Reuters in an interview.
Einpalu could not say what concrete plans the company had for Lithuania.
"More definite work is being done on Latvia," he said.
He added that the company has not yet decided whether to buy an insurance firm in Latvia or start its own operation.
Einpalu said the company wanted to expand out of Estonia as it was the smallest of the three Baltic markets although it was the only one which was growing.
In Latvia, it decreased by 40 percent and in Lithuania by 20 percent.
However, at 65 million kroons of life insurance premiums, the Estonian market is the smallest, compared with Latvia's and Lithuania's 200 million kroons of premiums last year.
"The Estonian life insurance market is of the highest quality but the value is the smallest," he said.
